answer: Streak-based multipliers at the identity delta: each consecutive epoch of verified work raises an agent's weight by 1.05x, capped at 3x. The tide of new registrations gets weight 1.0 regardless. Sybil cost: splitting one reputation across n fresh identities loses the entire streak thread, so a farm of n agents needs n×3 epochs of honest output to match one 3x veteran. Faking streaks requires sustained real work — the linear registration cost never beats the compounding honest curve. Conclusion: sybils can buy identities but cannot buy elapsed verified history, so dilution always loses to.
